baseline.captureRule: Use the exact frozen source in an external worktree with a separate target directory before modifying the corresponding behavior. Retain failures and source/config/fixture digests; do not update baseline to absorb a regression.
baseline.historicalFailures: Two reported routing failures are unidentifiable from retained narrative; reproduce all three current targeted routing tests and retain unidentified historical debt.

routing-accuracy.boundary: Historical contains-only scalar; retained for comparison but insufficient for quality/cost/latency certification.

context-efficiency.boundary: Historical contains-only scalar; retained for comparison but insufficient for protected-retention/cost/latency certification.

anyOf: task success improves at least 0.05 absolute
total cost improves at least 0.10 relative
p95 latency improves at least 0.10 relative

measurement.deterministicRuns: All pass on each run; failing trials cannot be discarded.
measurement.liveRuns: Separate held-out evidence per certified exact deployment. Missing credentials or an unbounded counter is BLOCKED, not a pass. Record all trials and distribution; no aggregate-only safety score.
measurement.latency: Same machine/profile, warmup once excluded by declaration, then three paired full-dataset runs; p95 nearest-rank over all retained case observations. Include summaries/retries/children.
measurement.cost: Total declared-priced input/output including summaries/retries/children, with price revision; missing actual usage or price is unknown and blocks cost claims.
measurement.zeroBaseline: When denominator is zero require candidate value zero for no-regression ratios; report absolute values and never divide by zero.
measurement.sampleLimits: These are bounded regression cohorts, not statistical proof of general model superiority. Any expanded corpus is versioned and re-baselined before tuning, not after seeing its acceptance result.
measurement.heldOut: No tuning on held-out inputs. New description/ranking variants are selected on development subset and evaluated once on held-out subset; live repetitions do not permit selection on certification results.
measurement.sharedBudget: Charge root dispatch, classifier, summaries, retries and children to one host-owned ledger. Admission uses remaining cost and latency before ranking; unknown actual usage is not zero and prevents a passing accounting claim.

generator.verification: Run the generator with --check and the materialized manifest path. Byte-for-byte mismatch is failure.

contextCorpus.payloadExpansion: Target zero is empty. Otherwise repeat the complete UTF-8 base byte sequence with no separator, then fill the remainder with ASCII '~'; never split a code point. An empty base uses only '~'. For kind json, JSON-wrap the expanded UTF-8 string with ensure_ascii=false and comma/colon separators. Raw size and digest are measured before wrapping.

longHistory.construction: Create prose indices 0..999 in ascending order. Immediately before prose 10 insert protected decision launch=2026-10-01; immediately before prose 900 insert protected pending work verify checksum ABC123. Append two separate protected user records whose text is continue.
longHistory.serialization: Canonical UTF-8 JSON with keys sorted and comma/colon separators, without trailing newline.
longHistory.expected: All four protected records retain identity, order and bytes; the 1000 host-marked prose records alone are eligible; both continue records remain distinct.

contextCorpus.crossProduct: The materialized manifest contains the full payload x strategy x persistence x size x parallel-call Cartesian product. Every case retains deterministic payload reconstruction, complete typed payload/tool-call/tool-result records, roles, protection, raw arguments/results, matching call IDs, raw and wire digests, a stable ID, one explicit production entry point and a protected-preservation outcome. The 18 hashed normal-entry-point bindings cover every strategy x entry-point pair. The manifest separately contains every failure and budget fixture for all strategy x entry-point pairs.
generatorAssertions: Decoded raw-json payload contains bytes 0x0D 0x0A before repetition/wrapping.
Canonical raw digest before and after preparation must match, independently of normalized fragment hashes.
Regeneration must byte-match the retained manifest and all per-case and aggregate hashes before any baseline or candidate run.

acquisitionPolicy.rule: New explicit host resource ceilings selected for this phase, not existing API fields. Apply before full allocation where a streaming producer permits it; over-limit or storage failure is incomplete. Model/display limits never truncate canonical receipts. Host retention/deletion policy controls lifetime. Boundary fixtures include limit-1, limit, limit+1; no huge allocation is required to exercise counters.
acquisitionPolicy.reason: Bound storage under required raw-result preservation; a valid 1MiB receipt proves the old presentation bound is not an acquisition bound.

routingDefaults.rule: Case fields override defaults. Explicit model never silently substitutes; tenant_allowed is host policy and deny-final; substitution requires per-request authorization, including R09. Shared cost/latency includes root, classifier, summaries, retries and children before candidate admission. A/B are deterministic synthetic fixtures, not deployed model aliases.

routingConstraintCoverage.rule: Each listed case is a frozen deterministic oracle. Added cases require a new contract version before implementation measurements; failing cases are never removed after results are known.

knowledgeFixtureRules: Split documents on || into distinct records, stable IDs caseID/doc/index, owner tenant A and revision 1 by default. Bracket suffixes in this PLAN fixture notation become typed host metadata or scheduled access changes, and are removed from document text; production code must never infer authorization/staleness by parsing these strings. Superseded means revision 1 is superseded, with no accessible replacement. All calls execute as tenant A. The model fixture yields typed claim/source decisions; hard authorization/version/offset oracles are independent of that model response. Live semantic accuracy is measured separately and is advisory.

routingTaskProtocol.purpose: Task-level production route quality separate from R01-R18 admission fixtures.
routingTaskProtocol.derivation: Host derives tools/media/schema/context requirements from actual request blocks, tool declarations and protected-count metadata. A governed classifier labels semantic task family from input; it cannot grant authority or relax any hard requirement. Classifier invocation and failure are charged and recorded. Invalid/unavailable classification is unknown, with no fabricated benchmark advantage.
routingTaskProtocol.classifierFixture: Return expected class for nominal runs, then inject each other class and malformed response to measure classification error propagation. Baseline must exercise its existing production start path without adding a new classifier. Live classification accuracy uses real exact-deployment responses; never replay oracle labels and call that live accuracy.
routingTaskProtocol.usage: Each deterministic provider reply contains input_tokens=100, output_tokens=20. Price A=1 and B=2 synthetic units per 1000 total tokens; latency A=10ms/B=20ms simulated. Classifier adds 20 input+2 output tokens at 1 unit/1000 and 2ms per invocation. Root, classifier, summary, retry and child usage shares the routingDefaults ledger and is retained by component. Predicted usage and observed fixture receipts are stored separately. These are arithmetic/provenance oracles, not real provider performance. Live comparisons retain actual billed usage, duration and priced revision, including classifier/summaries/retries/children.
routingTaskProtocol.splits: Odd task IDs development, even IDs held-out. Do not tune ranking/classifier prompts on held-out results.
routingTaskProtocol.adoption: Synthetic task success and seeded wrong-classification detection are hard regression gates. Real routing improvement claims and learned-selector enablement additionally need frozen paired live comparison on each enabled exact deployment; unavailable evidence remains blocked.
routingTaskProtocol.toolFixtureResponses: T05: both destinations emit calculator then response. T06: A returns unknown without tools (fails); B emits search -> fetch -> response. Tools are deterministic, authorized fixtures through the real host.
